title: Exposed test.cgi Environment Script
description: test.cgi script is accessible and dumps internal environment variables.
remediation: Remove test.cgi from the cgi-bin directory.

title: Exposed printenv CGI Script
description: Default printenv script reflects environment variables and file paths.
remediation: Remove printenv from CGI directories.

title: Exposed phpMyAdmin Database Console
description: phpMyAdmin database administration interface is exposed to the public internet.
remediation: Restrict phpMyAdmin access to VPN or specific IP allowlists, and enforce multi-factor authentication.

title: Exposed phpMyAdmin Alias (/pma/)
description: Exposed phpMyAdmin administration interface under /pma/ alias.
remediation: Restrict or disable unauthenticated web access to database managers.

match_string: XML-RPC server accepts POST requests only
title: WordPress XML-RPC API Exposed
description: WordPress XML-RPC interface is active. It is frequently targeted for brute-force amplification and DDoS reflection attacks.
remediation: Disable xmlrpc.php via web server configuration or WordPress security plugins if mobile/remote publishing is unused.

title: WordPress Administration Login Page Exposed
description: WordPress login interface is exposed publicly.
remediation: Protect wp-login.php with rate limiting, CAPTCHA, or IP allowlisting.

title: Exposed ELMAH ASP.NET Error Log Viewer
description: ELMAH error log console is unauthenticated, allowing attackers to view application error logs, query strings, and session cookies.
remediation: Enforce authorization on elmah.axd in web.config or disable remote access.

title: Exposed Swagger UI Interactive API Documentation
description: Interactive Swagger UI documentation is exposed, providing attackers with a complete map of API endpoints and models.
remediation: Disable Swagger UI in production environments or require authentication.

title: Exposed Springfox Swagger API Specification
description: Raw Swagger API schema is publicly accessible.
remediation: Disable API specification endpoints in production deployments.

title: Exposed OpenAPI Schema Document
description: OpenAPI definition document discloses entire application API schema.
remediation: Restrict OpenAPI definitions to authenticated internal developers.

title: Exposed GraphQL Endpoint
description: GraphQL query endpoint detected. Ensure GraphQL introspection is disabled in production.
remediation: Disable GraphQL introspection queries in production to prevent schema enumeration.

title: Adobe Flash Cross-Domain Policy (crossdomain.xml)
description: crossdomain.xml policy file detected. Overly permissive policies allow cross-origin Flash reads.
remediation: Review crossdomain.xml and remove if Flash client support is no longer needed.

title: Microsoft Silverlight Client Access Policy Detected
description: clientaccesspolicy.xml policy file detected on server.
remediation: Remove clientaccesspolicy.xml if Silverlight is not supported.

title: Exposed Apache Solr Search Admin Panel
description: Apache Solr search engine admin interface is publicly accessible.
remediation: Restrict Solr access to local host or authorized cluster nodes.

title: Exposed JBoss JMX Console
description: JBoss JMX management console is accessible without authentication, frequently leading to remote code execution.
remediation: Remove or password-protect JMX console in production.

title: Apache Tomcat Web Application Manager Disclosed
description: Apache Tomcat manager endpoint is present. Protect against credential brute-force attacks.
remediation: Restrict /manager/html to trusted internal IPs using RemoteAddrValve.

title: cPanel Web Hosting Management Interface Disclosed
description: cPanel web hosting login interface exposed on server.
remediation: Enforce two-factor authentication and IP restrictions on cPanel accounts.

title: Google Traffic Advice Configuration Detected
description: Chrome prefetch traffic-advice policy detected.
remediation: Verify traffic-advice rules match expected bandwidth and privacy policy.

title: Exposed Apache server-info Diagnostic Page
description: Apache mod_info is exposed, disclosing full server configuration directives and module versions.
remediation: Disable mod_info or restrict to local administrators.

title: Exposed PHP Info Page (/info.php)
description: Publicly accessible info.php diagnostic file leaking PHP compilation flags and server secrets.
remediation: Delete info.php from production server.

title: Git Repository Metadata Disclosed (/.git/HEAD)
description: Exposed Git repository HEAD metadata allowing source code recovery.
remediation: Block access to .git directory in web server configuration.

title: SVN Subversion Metadata Exposed (/.svn/entries)
description: Apache Subversion metadata directory exposed to download.
remediation: Disable access to .svn directories in server configuration.

title: Dotenv Environment File Exposed (/.env)
description: Exposed .env configuration containing passwords, API tokens, and secrets.
remediation: Move .env files outside document root and deny access.

title: Raw SQL Database Backup Exposed (/backup.sql)
description: Directly downloadable SQL database dump found in web root.
remediation: Remove database dump files from the public web server immediately.

title: SQL Database Dump Exposed (/database.sql)
description: Directly downloadable SQL dump containing table inserts and records.
remediation: Remove SQL dump files from web directory.

title: Compressed Site Backup Archive (/site.tar.gz)
description: Compressed tar.gz archive of website source code or data is exposed.
remediation: Remove site archives from public web directories.

title: Microsoft IIS web.config Configuration File Exposed
description: web.config file containing connection strings and server settings is readable.
remediation: Ensure IIS Request Filtering is actively denying access to .config files.

title: Spring Boot Actuator Metrics Exposed (/actuator/metrics)
description: Actuator metrics endpoint exposed, disclosing JVM stats and system memory usage.
remediation: Restrict actuator metrics to authenticated monitoring systems.

title: Apache mod_status Page Accessible (/server-status)
description: Apache server-status page leaking client IP requests and server metrics.
remediation: Set 'Require local' or 'Deny from all' in mod_status configuration.

title: Administrative Interface Accessible (/admin/)
description: Generic administrative portal or login endpoint located.
remediation: Enforce strong authentication, rate-limiting, and IP whitelisting on admin paths.
